UserWorkspaceLog.title: UserWorkspaceLog
UserWorkspaceLog.description: Log of a Google Workspace activity executed in the app

userId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who performed the action

service.description: The Workspace service name, e.g., Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets

action.description: The action performed, e.g., Send Email, Create Event, Append Row

KeepNote.title: KeepNote
KeepNote.description: Custom Keep-style note stored securely in Firestore

userId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who owns this note

color.description: Hex color code or class name of the note background

updatedAt.description: When the note was last modified

VoiceCommand.title: VoiceCommand
VoiceCommand.description: Synced log of a voice command and its corresponding response

userId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who owns this voice command

id.description: Local/Cloud unique ID of the voice command

title.description: The title of the voice command

messages.description: Conversation messages associated with this voice command

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of when this log was last updated

VoiceSession.title: VoiceSession
VoiceSession.description: Synced voice call recording metadata with duration, simulated audio path, and full text transcript

userId.description: The Firebase UID of the user who owns this voice session

title.description: The custom or default name of the voice session

audioPath.description: Simulated local file system path for cross-platform representation

transcript.description: Full accumulated voice session text transcript

model.description: The AI model used for the voice session

hasRecording.description: Whether an encrypted stereo audio file was saved locally for this session

audioMimeType.description: The MIME type of the recorded audio file

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of when this session was last updated

users/{userId}/workspace_logs/{logId}.description: Historical log of Google Workspace integrations actions for the user

users/{userId}/voice_commands/{commandId.description: Synced voice command and wake-word triggers log

users/{userId}/voice_sessions/{sessionId.description: Voice sessions with secure metadata, transcription, and status tracking
